choices.text:
The loop at lines 9–12 follows `default_table` pointers without rechecking that each new `j` is within bounds (the check at line 6 only applies to the initial state). A differential state can point to another differential state whose `default_table` value is out of range, causing an out-of-bounds read on `d->is_differential[j]` / `d->default_table[j]` in the next iteration. Additionally, cycles among differential states would loop forever. The bug is introduced by following the parent without validating it.

Answer: 11
